verdict.rationale: Activepieces documents its own TypeScript piece-building framework for custom connectors, including a fast local dev loop, so the core capability is first-party. However, the evidence is thin: two short doc snippets cover piece building, and nothing shows how a custom piece is privately published or distributed, nor any piece-scaffolding CLI or SDK reference for it. missing for 10: documented private/custom piece publishing to a self-hosted or cloud instance, an evidenced piece-scaffolding CLI or SDK reference, in-depth piece-framework docs (auth, triggers, actions), independent or hands-on corroboration of building a custom piece

support.subject: As a developer, I can build a custom connector or private integration with a documented developer platform, SDK, or CLI

citations.quote: Build pieces using TypeScript for a more powerful and flexible development process.
